edits.old: Then the build fails and nothing is released when one does
edits.new:
Then the build fails and nothing is released when one does

  Scenario: AC7 Activity retry and timeout (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock does not answer the ACE asset read inside 2 s
    When the take-on step runs
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's own schedule
    Then nothing is written and no case move is answered

  Scenario: AC8 Consumed call fails (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-source-data contract mock answers the ACE asset read with a failure
    When the take-on step runs
    Then nothing is written and no case move is answered
    Then the step waits and retries on the workflow's own schedule

  Scenario: AC9 Disallowed transition is refused (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a case in state ASSET_ON_BOOKS
    When the take-on step runs
    Then the step changes nothing and reports the reason to the parent

  Scenario: AC10 Error answers of the provided operations (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a role without the Asset and disposal right of the operation
    When it calls the take-on operation
    Then 403 is answered with MSG-P4-002 before any read or write
    Then the 401 and 404 answers are Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-S5-E3021-APP-AC8)

  Scenario: AC11 Duplicate delivery of a consumed event (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-litigation event AuctionResult for property AST-2026-000521 is delivered twice
    When the take-on step runs
    Then one asset row, one AssetTakenOn event and one case-move answer are written
